english.title: Drop / jump from aircraft over UK other than in accordance with certificate / permission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[dropped to the surface]_
(B)_[dropped **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to the surface]_
(C)_[permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to drop to the surface]_
(D)_[jumped]_

from an aircraft flying over the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), except under and in accordance with the terms of either a police air operator's certificate or a parachuting permission granted by the CAA under article 90 of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 90(1) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.

english.notes:
(i) Nothing in this article applies to the descent of persons by parachute from an aircraft in an emergency.
(ii) Nothing in this article prohibits the lowering of any person in an emergency or for the purpose of saving life.
(iii) Nothing in this article prohibits the lowering of any person from a helicopter to the surface if there is a certificate of airworthiness issued or rendered valid for the helicopter under the law of the country in which it is registered and that certificate or the flight manual for the helicopter includes an express provision that it may be used for that purpose.
